The '''1960 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 15th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 12 teams.

[[Boldklubben 1909]] unsuccessfully defended its [[1959 Danish 1st Division|1959 title]]. [[Aarhus Gymnastikforening]] successfully pursued its 1960 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1960 season.
